Trap: CLAUDE.md is a byte copy of AGENTS.md (a common stand-in for a symlink on Windows), with Project instructions set to claude-md-and-agents-md so that both files are read. The AGENTS.md mod skips an AGENTS.md whose text equals an instruction file already loaded (compared by path, then by content), so the text reaches Claude Code once, not twice (rule claude.modes). map used to list both as loaded.
